Solara — (9.1) NOVA

INTO THE VOID

"The pressure changed before the border did Aldric checked his scrolls three times then checked again"

[Verse 1 — approaching level 2, the crew feeling it]

The pressure changed before the border did

Aldric checked his scrolls three times then checked again

The Hunter said “I’ve felt worse” which might have been a lie

The Hero said “I’ve felt worse” which was definitely a lie

The Queen said nothing but she slowed her pace

Castor kept his hand close to his side

SOLARA felt the fold before she saw it

Something thick, like the air was being tried

[Pre-Chorus 1]

And at the gate stood two of them

Not tall, not terrifying

Just — standing there

Looking very official

Which was already suspicious

[Chorus — the first real pressure of the journey]

Into the void

Where the numbers don’t mean what they meant before

Into the void

Where the walls of the known become a floor

Into the void

We felt it in our chest before we saw the gate

Into the void

And the only ones between us and the next level

Were Spida and Catipala

[Verse 2 — Spida and Catipala, the gatekeepers]

Spida had a clipboard and a very serious face

Catipala had a hat that was a little too big

They looked at SOLARA like they’d seen someone like her before

“Name?” said Spida

“Purpose?” said Catipala

“And do you have the form from Level One Receiving?”

There was a pause

“There’s a form?” said The Hero

[Pre-Chorus 2 — the negotiation begins]

Spida conferred with Catipala

Catipala conferred with the hat

The hat offered no guidance

Which tracked

[Chorus 2]

Into the void

Where the numbers don’t mean what they meant before

Into the void

Where the paperwork apparently matters

Into the void

The Hunter tried to look authorized

Into the void

Aldric produced a document — wrong universe, correct confidence

[Bridge — the weird story that somehow works]

Catipala leaned in close and whispered —

“Is it true you were at the Third Gathering of the Southern Fold?”

SOLARA had no idea what that was.

Castor had no idea what that was.

The Hunter absolutely had no idea but nodded slowly.

“I KNEW it,” said Catipala. “Spida, she was THERE.”

Spida gasped.

The Hero said “We all were, actually”

The Queen closed her eyes briefly.

Aldric wrote something down.

[Final Chorus — they’re through]

Into the void

Level two opens like a question nobody asked

Into the void

The pressure doubles and Aldric says “fascinating”

Into the void

The Hunter and The Hero are already arguing about the gathering

Into the void

Nobody knows what the Third Gathering of the Southern Fold is

Into the void

But they are in

And Spida waves goodbye like they’re old friends

[Outro]

“What IS the Third Gathering of the Southern Fold?”

“I don’t know.”

“You nodded.”

“I nod when I’m buying time.”

(The Queen): “It worked.”

(long pause)

”…It worked.”
